name: Doctor of Philosophy - Law
previous:
The Doctor of Philosophy in Law at the University of Melbourne gives doctoral candidates outstanding research training at Australia's leading law school, supported by an experienced supervisor and Advisory Committee. Candidates produce a thesis demonstrating authority in their field, a thorough grasp of relevant methodology, and the potential to change legal understanding and practice.
Melbourne Law School is ranked first in Australia and eighth globally, home to internationally recognised scholars. Graduates pursue careers in academia, research leadership and legal scholarship.

Melbourne Law School is ranked first in Australia and eighth globally, home to internationally recognised scholars. Graduates pursue careers in academia, research leadership and legal scholarship.
The listed duration is 4 years full-time or 8 years part-time, with an expected candidature of 3 years full-time or part-time equivalent. Study is on campus at Parkville, with a flexible start date.

name: Master of Philosophy - Architecture, Building and Planning
previous:
The Master of Philosophy (Architecture, Building and Planning) at the Melbourne School of Design is a higher-level research degree for outstanding local and international graduates investigating a specific built environment problem or issue. Working under academic supervisors and an advisory committee, candidates progress through structured milestones toward a thesis demonstrating a critical application of specialist knowledge.
Graduates gain an internationally recognised research qualification, with many going on to leading built environment practices in Australia and around the world.

name: Master of Philosophy - Law
previous:
The Master of Philosophy (Law) at the University of Melbourne is an internationally recognised research master's degree, with candidates undertaking a substantial piece of original research under academic supervision, externally examined by internationally standing scholars in the thesis field. The thesis demonstrates a critical application of specialist knowledge and makes an independent contribution to existing scholarship.
Melbourne Law School is ranked first in Australia and eighth globally. Graduates hold positions at local and international universities, agencies and in legal practice.

name: Master of Philosophy - Psychological Sciences
previous:
The Master of Philosophy (Psychological Sciences) at the University of Melbourne is an internationally recognised research master's degree developing advanced skills in independent, sustained research in psychology. Candidates enrol in a thesis subject for a normal candidature of 18 months full-time, completing at least six months of full-time research at the University under expert academic supervision.
Melbourne is ranked first in Australia and 19th in the world for psychology. Graduates produce a significant thesis making a unique contribution to psychological sciences scholarship.

name: Master of Philosophy - Veterinary Science
previous:
The Master of Philosophy (Veterinary Science) at the University of Melbourne is an internationally recognised research master's degree developing advanced skills in independent and sustained research, with candidates producing a 30,000 to 40,000 word thesis across areas including veterinary biosciences, animal health and welfare, and infectious diseases. Research is conducted under academic supervision with a critical application of specialist knowledge.
Melbourne is ranked 20th in the world for veterinary science. Many graduates go on to a PhD and careers in research, teaching or industry.

name: Master of Surgery
previous:
The Master of Surgery (by Research) at the University of Melbourne lets students undertake research in a specific aspect of surgery under academic supervision, advancing their knowledge, research skills and competencies in surgical practice and patient care. Students complete a minimum of six months of full-time research at the University, drawing on current evidence-based practices and research methodologies.
Graduates gain the competencies to independently conduct surgical research and meet entry requirements for further research degrees or academic roles in surgery.
description:

Graduates gain the competencies to independently conduct surgical research and meet entry requirements for further research degrees or academic roles in surgery.
